blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A total of 35,105 kilograms of waste were collected along the shorelines of the Calabarzon region during activities marking this year’s International Coastal Cleanup (ICC). “Heartfelt thanks to all our volunteers! The recently held International Coastal Cleanup, themed ‘Clean Seas for Resilient Communities,’ was a tremendous success for our environment,” the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)-Calabarzon said in a report Sunday morning, Sept. 20.
